taste-baroque v1.0.4

- Added new footer section inviting users to share their projects and contact InspiredHub.
- No other content or functional changes.
Added Live Demo link — try the skill at inspiredhub.ai/demo before installing

- Removed non-essential files: README.md and skill.json.
- SKILL.md significantly revised for conciseness and structure.
- Overview, style tokens, and anti-tokens streamlined into bulleted lists.
- Three defining Baroque works retained with briefer analysis.
- Added a specific color palette and mood descriptors.
- Application rules clarified for writing, UI, and branding.
- Introduced concrete evaluation criteria for this skill.
Initial release: 10 style tokens, 5 anti-tokens, 3 signature works, application rules — distilled from 6,034 museum-archived works
